title: CrimsonSMP PLugin

body:
# 🔥 CrimsonSMP Plugin - Season 1 & 2

**CrimsonSMP**, custom plugin with **13+ unique Auras**, custom items, custom crafting recipes, abilities, and a custom resource pack.

Whether you're creating an SMP with friends or looking to add fresh progression to your server, CrimsonSMP brings exciting new mechanics that fit perfectly into survival gameplay.

## ✨ Features

* ⚡ 13+ Powerful Custom Auras
* 🔨 Custom Crafting Recipes
* 🎨 Custom Textures & Resource Pack
* ⚔️ New Combat & Utility Items
* 💎 End-Game Progression
* 🌎 Multiplayer Friendly
* 🏹 Balanced Survival Gameplay

---

# 🎮 Installation

1. Install the plugin into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Add the provided resource pack to your server.
3. Restart the server.
4. Start crafting and collecting auras.
